guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Archive port, record accessors, implementation, and errors have rustdoc; cargo fmt, Clippy, and repository tests pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not import internal modules from other features.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Archive boundary imports only Weekly Radar Domain values and its own receipt boundary; public E2E composition passes architecture checks.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep E2E orchestration in tests; the Archive boundary may retain only supplied snapshot/receipt values and must not add external persistence merely to make the test pass.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Ordering and transport orchestration remain in tests; InMemoryWeeklyRadarArchive stores only supplied values and has no external persistence dependency.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use fixed timestamps, cutoff values, facts, and in-memory transports; never use Telegram credentials or real network calls in tests.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The E2E test uses fixed snapshot/cutoff/clock values and RecordingTransport; no provider credentials, HTTP client, or network call is used.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat the existing WI as the repair boundary for defects discovered here; do not create a new WI unless the change is outside this E2E/workflow scope.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Archive gap, failure-injector defect, and semantic chunk-count expectation were corrected inside WR-015; no new WI was opened.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep actions/checkout@v5 in both workflow checkout steps and do not reintroduce @v4.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The workflow fixture test proves exactly two v5 references, zero v4 references, and two fetch-depth 0 settings.

risk.detail: The deterministic local flow is fully exercised; real Telegram delivery, durable archive storage, runtime timer/timezone wiring, and CI execution remain outside this provider-isolated Work Item.

observedIssues.issue: The initial RecordingTransport consumed the one-shot failure marker on the first nonmatching message, so the configured later chunk did not fail.
observedIssues.impact: The first red E2E run incorrectly returned Published instead of a typed partial failure.
observedIssues.resolution: Changed the fixture to clear fail_once_at only when the configured message index is reached; the failure and retry assertions now pass.

observedIssues.issue: The initial E2E expectation assumed two semantic chunks, but the renderer emitted Executive Summary, Important Structural Change, and System Health boundaries.
observedIssues.impact: The E2E retry fixture failed before reaching publication verification.
observedIssues.resolution: Updated the current WI assertion to cover the actual three complete semantic chunks and the existing retry contract's exact resend sequence.

observedIssues.issue: No production Archive boundary existed before WR-015, so a test-only archive ledger could not prove the requested Archive step.
observedIssues.impact: The initial success path verified only a local test helper rather than a production boundary.
observedIssues.resolution: Added the scoped provider-agnostic append-only InMemoryWeeklyRadarArchive and replaced the test-only ledger in the public E2E test.

observedIssues.issue: The coverage guard association for the changed infrastructure mod.rs requires a changed mod_test path.
observedIssues.impact: The first strict Finish attempt stopped at aiCoverage despite behavior tests already passing.
observedIssues.resolution: Added a focused module-registration assertion to the existing tests/mod_test.rs within WR-015 and revalidated coverage successfully.

residualRisks.detail: Telegram HTTP delivery, credentials, provider configuration, and CI runtime execution are intentionally not exercised by the deterministic E2E test.
The Archive is an in-memory provider-agnostic boundary; durable storage, timer/cron, timezone conversion, and persisted scheduler state remain outside WR-015.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: The focused E2E injects one later-chunk failure, asserts the typed Partial receipt and unchanged snapshot identity, retries at attempt two, and compares the exact ordered payload calls.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: No structural change produces an explicit no-change Markdown/Telegram output without fabricated sections.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: The focused E2E builds empty WeeklyChangeCompression and NoChangeSummary inputs, checks stable Markdown and explicit NO_CHANGE output, and forbids fabricated Top5/Rising/Dropped sections.
